ValidationRule.description: Enter the 7 text fields in numbers for Bottlers.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND ( ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c,'JP'), CONTAINS($UserRole.Name ,'Bottler HQ'), NOT(ISNUMBER(VM_Instalation_Number__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(VM_Instalation_Number__c)) ), AND ( ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c,'JP'), CONTAINS($UserRole.Name ,'Bottler HQ'), NOT(ISNUMBER(number_of_visits__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(number_of_visits__c)) ), AND ( ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c,'JP'), CONTAINS($UserRole.Name ,'Bottler HQ'), NOT(ISNUMBER(Time_spent_for_settlement__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Time_spent_for_settlement__c)) ), AND ( ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c,'JP'), CONTAINS($UserRole.Name ,'Bottler HQ'), NOT(ISNUMBER(Sample_Products__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Sample_Products__c)) ), AND ( ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c,'JP'), CONTAINS($UserRole.Name ,'Bottler HQ'), NOT(ISNUMBER(Quantity_Collected__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Quantity_Collected__c)) ), AND ( ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c,'JP'), CONTAINS($UserRole.Name ,'Bottler HQ'), NOT(ISNUMBER(Estimated_Price__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Estimated_Price__c)) ), AND ( ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c,'JP'), CONTAINS($UserRole.Name ,'Bottler HQ'), NOT(ISNUMBER(Sales_Volume__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Sales_Volume__c)) ) )
